summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — the name appears twice in the Epitome list, likely a scribal duplication rather than two distinct wooers.

story.text: Apollodorus names Phrenius among the Zacynthian wooers after Molebus and again later in the same catalogue after Stratius — a single figure entered twice in the manuscript tradition of Epitome 7.29.
